invariants.text: Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.name must be a string
Product.name must not be null
Product.price must be a number
Product.price must not be null
SalesRecord.sales_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
SalesRecord.product_id must be an integer
SalesRecord.product_id must not be null
SalesRecord.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
SalesRecord.quantity must be an integer
SalesRecord.quantity must not be null
SalesRecord.sale_date must be a datetime
SalesRecord.sale_date must not be null
The total sales amount for a product is calculated by multiplying the product's price by the sum of the quantities of all sales records for that product.
The number of sales per product is the count of sales records associated with that product's product_id.
A sales record must reference a product that exists in the Product table via the product_id field.
The sale_date in a SalesRecord must be a valid date and cannot be in the future.
The quantity in a SalesRecord must be a positive integer greater than zero.
The price in a Product must be a positive numeric value greater than zero.
A product must have a unique name across all products in the database.
Each sales record must have a unique sales_id that corresponds to a single entry in the SalesRecord table.
The total sales amount reported must reflect the sum of (price * quantity) across all sales records for each product.
The number of sales per product reported must match the count of sales records grouped by product_id.
